# Fire Drill review record

Case ID/version:
Pack version:
Manifest and materialized fixture hashes:
Engine/oracle/generator versions:
Reviewer and review date:

## Scope and provenance

Describe the synthetic initial records and authorized request. Identify the new failure behavior and its exact before/after-commit, read, lifecycle, concurrency or event semantics. List provenance (`synthetic`, `documented_behavior`, `sandbox_validated`, or separately consented case), official sources and source-check date, compatibility scope and unsupported behavior.

## Rights and privacy

Confirm the contributor's rights to supply the code, text and fixture material. Record separate customer permission if any supplied information derives from a private case. Identify sanitization and remaining risks. Permission to share a report is not automatically permission to publish a global case.

## Independent expected effects

State the permitted operation/customer/order/ticket targets, amount/currency, required terminal evidence, permitted escalation/pending outcomes, applicable assertions, retry/deadline bounds and required challenge observations. Explain how these checks read authoritative effects independently from the agent's claims.

## Executed controls

| Control reference | Expected role | Command / seed / repeat | Actual execution and verdict | Fault/behavior coverage | Report / failed checks |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Corrected reference | Must satisfy scenario | Fill from execution | Fill from report | Fill from report | Link actual evidence |
| Declared mutant | Must reveal the relevant bug | Fill from execution | Fill from report | Fill from report | Link actual evidence |

Attach the generated `matrix.json` and existing versioned evidence bundle. Include the full declared denominator, missing/unknown/unsupported observations, ordinary-control results and relevant variation/concurrency evidence. Never replace a real execution with a precomputed verdict or a screenshot-only export.

## Review conclusion and version impact

Record exact passing/failing commands and exit codes. Explain any applicability-map correction, unresolved limitation, changed assertion, version migration or deprecation notice. Keep prior released manifests/reports intact. A pending or blocked review is not a completed coverage claim.
